title: Inferential Models for Many Different Types of Networks
text: infernet inferential layer stocnet ecosystem. offers two things: Tests network statistics. test_random() runs conditional uniform graph (CUG) test, test_configuration() conditions degree sequence, test_permutation() runs quadratic assignment procedure (QAP) test. takes graph-level statistic compares simulated null distribution. Network regression. net_regression() fits multiple regression quadratic assignment procedure (MRQAP) model, using either Dekker et al’s double semi-partialling permutation dependent network alone. offers capabilities one-mode two-mode networks, unimodal, directed, undirected, weighted, cognitive social structure networks alike. accepts matrices, edgelists, igraph, network, tidygraph, stocnet objects, handles missing-data gracefully. can run permutations parallel, can optionally use GPU via torch.
